snippet.title: Something Rush (No Commentary Longplay) ALL ENDINGS
snippet.description:
ABOUT THE GAME:
You're a detective on a case involving three murders in one night.
The police are clueless about the killer, is it a lone madman, or the gangster, or else?

DEVELOPER: flycat games
PUBLISHER: flycat games
AVAILABLE ON: Itch.io 
RELEASE YEAR: 2024
SYSTEM: PC / Windows
SIMILAR GAMES: Haunted Horsepower, Junkyard Fury, Rustbucket Revenge, Decimate Drive, Car-tastrophe, Killer Junkyard, Coffin Mall, Drive Me to Hell

LICENSE: This video is under the "Standard YouTube License" but can still be used under "Fair Use." Feel free to use parts of this gameplay—just be sure to mention my channel, and we're good.
This game was recorded and played by me and has never been published or uploaded anywhere else.
If you see this exact playthrough on any other channel, you can be sure it's a reupload without permission.
